annotations.text:
AGENCY SURFACE

One screen, not a 9-step wizard. A trader fills six fields and hits Create; 'Guide me' opens the same section as a drawer for less technical users.

Note what is absent: no margin, no supply cost, no SSP name. Supply path says 'PGAM Supply' until Advanced is chosen.

ATTENTION IS STRUCTURAL

The Inventory section leads with attention tier — the deal is built FROM measured placements, not from a publisher list.

The am- ramp (am-9 #E67A1F) carries attention and nothing else: not nav state, not in-progress pills, not inventory metadata. The warning colours you see elsewhere are the separate ss-orange semantic family — adjacent in hue, different meaning.

TWO HONESTY RULES ON SCREEN

1. Every forecast number carries its source — 'PGAM historical' vs 'PGAM estimate'. One panel legitimately mixes them.

2. Create says 'ready in about 40 minutes', not instant. Fulfilment is human today; the ETA comes from measured p50. When a write API lands this resolves in seconds and the copy changes itself.

THE FLOOR FIELD

Commercially the most sensitive input — it sets PGAM's margin. The agency sees clearing guidance ('$21 is the lowest we'd recommend'). It never sees the spread.

IMPORTED DEALS

Existing PMP deals on buyer 69397 can be read today, so the library is useful from launch rather than starting empty. Badged 'Imported' and attention shows n/a — we report on them but didn't build them.

THE DEAL ID IS THE PAYLOAD

It is what the buyer came for, so it gets the largest type on the page, a copy button, and the three DSP-specific steps beside it.

Attention lift sits underneath as the reason to come back.

INTERNAL SURFACE — the mirror image

Darker chrome and an INTERNAL tag so it can never be mistaken for the agency view.

This is the one place the full waterfall appears: buyer floor − SSP price − 25.5% take − data = PGAM margin, labelled 'never shown to agency'.

The third row is the unviable-floor case: a $16 floor that would lose $1.20 CPM, with a suggested floor rather than a silent loss.
